title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: Documentation and Authorization Unit Standard on the Starting Day and Anchor of a Renewal's 30-Day Blocks
content:
**Standard.** For a renewal written order for the CGM supply allowance (HCPCS A4239) under the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, where the grant's 30-day blocks start, and the date the grant is anchored to, depend on the authorization and the supply already in place on the order date.

**Formal clause.** The block-start adjustment replaces the standard blocks and anchor: when a grant of the item is still valid on the order date, the blocks are counted from the day after that grant's valid-through date through the order's valid-through date, and the grant is anchored to that valid-through date; when no grant is still valid but the latest refill's supply, its ship date plus its supply days, runs past the order date, the blocks are counted from the end of that supply through the order's valid-through date, both days counted, the grant staying anchored to the order date; otherwise the standard blocks and anchor apply.

**Readings.**

- A grant whose valid-through date is the order date itself is still valid on that date.
- The end of the latest refill's supply is its ship date plus its supply days; the supply runs past the order date when that end date falls after the order date.
- Whole 30-day blocks are the complete 30-day blocks in the counted days; a remainder of fewer than 30 days adds no block.

**The three cases.**

| Case | What the records show | First counted day | Last counted day | Anchor date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | a grant of the item still valid on the order date | the day after that grant's valid-through date | the order's valid-through date | that grant's valid-through date |
| 2 | no grant of the item still valid on the order date, and the latest refill's supply ends after the order date | the end of that supply (ship date plus supply days) | the order's valid-through date | the order date |
| 3 | neither case 1 nor case 2, including no refill of the item on file or a latest refill whose supply ends on or before the order date | the standard blocks and anchor apply | the standard blocks and anchor apply | the standard blocks and anchor apply |

Both the first and the last counted day are included in cases 1 and 2.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).** A grant valid through the order date falls in case 1; a grant valid through the day before the order date does not. A latest refill whose supply ends on the day after the order date falls in case 2; one whose supply ends on the order date itself falls in case 3.

**Illustrations on hypothetical dates.** Take a renewal order dated 10 April of a hypothetical Year 1, valid through 9 April of Year 2, neither year a leap year.

- Case 1: a grant of the item is valid through 30 June of Year 1. The blocks run from 1 July of Year 1 through 9 April of Year 2, 283 days, which is 9 whole blocks; the anchor date is 30 June of Year 1.
- Case 2: no grant is valid on 10 April; the latest refill shipped on 1 February of Year 1 with 90 days of supply, so its supply ends on 2 May of Year 1. The blocks run from 2 May of Year 1 through 9 April of Year 2, 343 days, which is 11 whole blocks; the anchor date is 10 April of Year 1.
- Case 3: no grant is valid on 10 April; the latest refill shipped on 1 January of Year 1 with 90 days of supply, ending on 1 April of Year 1. The standard blocks and anchor apply.

The dates above are illustrative inputs only.
